shadowSentences: The sun is shining brightly today.
I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Cooking a new recipe can be very exciting.
Traveling helps me learn about different cultures.
I often play soccer with friends on weekends.
Listening to music can improve my mood significantly.
I like to explore new hiking trails when I travel.
Volunteering at local shelters makes me feel fulfilled.
Keeping a journal has helped me reflect on my thoughts.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about family vacations.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable family vacation you have had?
Q2: What challenges did your family face while traveling together?
Q3: Why do you think family vacations are important for bonding?
Q4: What advice would you give to families planning a trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: How did you first become interested in environmental issues?
Q2: What obstacles do people face in adopting eco-friendly habits?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to protect the environment?
Q4: What suggestions do you have for individuals wanting to be more environmentally conscious?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about self-improvement.
questions: Q1: What personal development goal have you worked towards recently?
Q2: What difficulties have you encountered while trying to improve yourself?
Q3: How do you feel self-improvement impacts your overall happiness?
Q4: What tips would you share with someone looking to better themselves?
